Blacc Sam Confirms That Marathon Burger Will Officially Be Opening A Location Inside LAX Airport 🏁🍔✈️ Nipsey Hussle’s Legacy Continues To Grow 💙🕊️

Blacc Sam, whose real name is Samiel Asghedom, is a Los Angeles entrepreneur, businessman, and the older brother of legendary West Coast rapper Nipsey Hussle. Raised in the Crenshaw district of South Los Angeles, Blacc Sam played a major role in helping Nipsey build his business empire long before he became a household name. The two brothers worked together for years, starting with selling clothing and eventually opening their own businesses. Blacc Sam is best known as the co-founder of The Marathon Clothing, a brand that represents independence, ownership, and community empowerment. Following Nipsey’s passing in March 2019, Blacc Sam took on the responsibility of protecting his brother’s legacy and continuing the vision they built together. Today, he remains a key figure behind The Marathon brand, helping expand its influence beyond clothing while keeping Nipsey’s message of entrepreneurship, perseverance, and giving back to the community alive. 

Nipsey Hussle, born Ermias Joseph Asghedom on August 15, 1985, was a legendary Los Angeles rapper, entrepreneur, and community activist from the Crenshaw district of South Central Los Angeles. Widely regarded as one of the most influential figures in West Coast hip-hop, Nipsey built his career independently through projects such as Bullets Ain’t Got No Name, The Marathon, The Marathon Continues, and Crenshaw. His debut studio album, Victory Lap, released in 2018, earned him a Grammy nomination and solidified his place among hip-hop’s most respected artists. Beyond music, Nipsey was passionate about financial independence, business ownership, and creating opportunities for underserved communities. Alongside his brother Blacc Sam, he established The Marathon Clothing store at the historic intersection of Crenshaw and Slauson.
